amendment_reason: The r63 pilot reproduced the invalid tool response and traffic but exposed that DFLASH_KIMI_TOKEN_TRACE did not exist on this branch. The intervention gate had not run. Commit d4cb9c8b adds an opt-in prompt/generated token-ID trace and removes the unused variable. All arms are rerun with one rebuilt binary.

excluded_pilot.interpretation: MEASURED PILOT ONLY; invalid tool output, 147 prompt tokens, 45 generated tokens, 95.874129920 GB physical reads, but no generated-token-ID artifact. Do not use as the same-binary gate control.

arms.name: tool_name_window_b96
arms.run_only_if: singleton_boundary_b96 does not return a valid get_weather call

validity: All gate arms use one rebuilt executable hash and a clean source commit containing this amendment.
The prompt token-ID trace must contain 147 IDs and match the frozen i32le SHA-256.
The base arm must have no progressive-rescue marker; rescue arms must contain exactly their preregistered base-position markers and no request-wide Budget96 marker.
Every arm records generated token IDs, response JSON, final logits, logical provider bytes, physical direct-read bytes, provider exact-fallback bytes and timings.

gate.pass: A rescue arm returns exactly one native-valid get_weather tool call with JSON argument location San Francisco without request-wide Budget96.
gate.traffic: Report total and average bytes over every provider position, plus rescue records/bytes above the H23 base table.
gate.stop: If the four-position window fails, stop positional Budget96 rescue on this fixture and investigate earlier-state or representation damage; do not widen adaptively.
gate.next_if_pass: Replace the position oracle with a grammar/tool-schema boundary trigger and rerun the same fixture plus non-tool controls.
